Sofia — quick notes below. Keeping it scoped to a PoC (10k requests):

- Acceptance suite (initial): 1,000 labelled examples covering top 10 intents (50–150 per intent depending on variance) + 200 adversarial/red-team cases (safety and hallucination checks). Include a 150-case deterministic seed set (fingerprinting prompts) for reproducibility across model builds.
- Regression suite (monthly): 2,000 sampled requests stratified by intent and token length buckets with 25% high-risk tags (as defined by policy rules). We run full metrics (accuracy for classification tasks, ROUGE/BERTScore for summarization, safety classifier F1, hallucination rate measured by targeted fact-check prompts).
- Drift and alerting: We recommend run-of-system monitors: delta in top-label distribution, median response length shifts, and calibration drift (expected confidence vs observed accuracy). Thresholds: trigger triage at 5–7% label distribution change or >10% increase in hallucination rate month-over-month.
- Determinism: For seed tests, store KV-cache and runtime seeds in artifact store; provide a signed checksum so Greenbank can validate artifact integrity.

Attachments: Regression_Sampling_Plan.xlsx (contains class weights, exact sample sizes, and metric formulas).

Happy to walk through Monday morning if needed.

-ben
